name: Summon Skeletons Necromancer
summary: League-start minion build. Skeletons do the damage, so a bad weapon is not a brick: cap your resistances, keep your minions alive, and the damage arrives with the gem levels. No required uniques, which is why it is the first build the pipeline proves.

leveling.name: Small Life Flask
leveling.note: Upgrade to Divine as soon as one drops.

maps.name: Quicksilver Flask
maps.note: Adrenaline suffix when you can craft it.

maps.name: Amethyst Flask
maps.note: Chaos resistance while it is short.

maps.name: Quartz Flask
maps.note: Phasing, so your minions block the doorway instead of you.

endgame.name: Amethyst Flask
endgame.note: Swap for a damage flask once chaos resistance is capped.

pantheon.note: Swap the major to Solaris for pinnacle bosses with physical slams.
